### Fixed

* **Live telemetry broken after v1.5.4.0** — restoring `const now = new Date()` in `updateClock()` fixes a JavaScript crash that stopped WebSocket connect, CPU/RAM/Disk/GPU bars, and app status badges (stuck on **CHECKING...**).

### Install / Upgrade

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Hard-refresh the dashboard (`Ctrl+Shift+R`) after upgrade. **Settings → System** should show `v1.5.4.2`.
